Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

lpplsF 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.

Features

  • fit_lppls() calibrates the LPPLS model in the Filimonov–Sornette parameterisation: by joint optimisation ("F1"), by profiling over a grid of critical times ("F2"), or by modified profile likelihood, with likelihood intervals for the critical time ("MPL").
  • print(), summary(), plot() and lppls_curvature() report the diagnostics that decide whether a calibration can be trusted: boundary solutions, split optimisation basins, the B and damping filters, and where the modified profile likelihood is defined.
  • lppls_rolling(), lppls_lagrange() and lr_trend_test() date the start of a bubble by Lagrange regularisation, with an autocorrelation-robust test of the trend the regularisation removes.
  • lppls_noise_sweep() recalibrates a known signal across a range of noise levels, with any noise generator.
  • fit_plot(), sse_surface_plot(), sse_contour_plot(), residual_qq_plot() and the rolling, Lagrange and noise plots draw the fits, the SSE landscapes and the diagnostics.
  • spx holds the S&P 500 daily close from 2009-05-18 to 2020-12-31.
